additional_info.subject: RE: ID0436866-DC/Si-D/FR-[MP / R5 170001863] Issue with charging session CRM:02889000187
additional_info.body:
Dear Theo SALMON,
I hope you are doing well.
I have analyzed the logs and found that the outlet was out of order due to a SECC offline error.
If there’s a brief loss of communication with the SECC, the SiC D will reconnect within 5 seconds. During this time, an "SECC is offline" flag may appear on your backend, but it will be cleared once the reconnection is successful.
In this charger, I observed that the issue is resolved within a few seconds, and there is no impact on the ongoing session.
If you have any further questions, please don’t hesitate to reach out.
Looking forward to your feedback.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Ankita
